name: InsForge
description: The all-in-one, open-source backend platform for agentic coding. InsForge gives your coding agent database, auth, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway to ship full-stack apps end-to-end.
summary: 全栈开源代理编程后端平台。InsForge 为您提供编码代理数据库、认证、存储、计算、托管及 AI 网关，支持端到端全栈应用交付
categoryDescription: 开发、调试、评审、测试、架构与工程交付
howToUse: 阅读仓库 README 的安装要求，将 Skill、插件或工具接入对应环境，再按文档触发工作流。
installCommand:
git clone https://github.com/InsForge/InsForge.git
cd insforge
cp .env.example .env
